method: Read-only comparison of committed specifications and theorem source against existing exact-source finite reports and independent root De Moivre review. No new experiment/test/benchmark or source mutation.

checks.name: current_cache_scope
checks.detail: Both specs refute a positive fresh producer business-contraction floor after lawful preparation only within the admitted fixed cache scope. Receiver recomputation remains separate.

checks.name: classical_substitution
checks.detail: The min of L(mu_A+B_V) and mu_A+B_V+L(q_A+B_V)(q_A+B_V+1)/(2M) substitutes a deterministic total assisting-query ceiling into the existing classical theorem, retaining its chronology, independent seeds, injective domains and once-per-candidate award premises.

checks.name: all_assisting_sources
checks.detail: Q_V_callbacks <= K R L applies to one owner callback scope. B_V = K R L is permitted only if those callbacks cover every assisting step query; other owners, epochs, producer services and preprocessing must be added.

checks.name: disclosed_feedback
checks.detail: The total-query model allows the full charged classical verifier transcript, without proving the stronger endpoint-only feedback premise or charging B_V to the attacker.

checks.name: nonstep_cost
checks.detail: Seed hashes and parsing, signatures, startup, preparation, transport, storage and early rejected requests remain separate costs, outside the callback step-query measure.

checks.name: unknown_and_cache
checks.detail: Started unknown callbacks retain maximum possible cost; historical cached receipts do not add completions or revalidate live state.

checks.name: copied_budget
checks.detail: Eight local budgets of 16 give aggregate 128; exact mean credit 4 exceeds the invalid local bound 128/255 and is below the aggregate bound 128/31. This is a constructed finite model control.

checks.name: extra_bit_feedback
checks.detail: The synthetic endpoint-bit verifier permits reconstruction with zero own chain queries; equality closure does not restore the equality-only premise. No native side channel is asserted.

checks.name: small_target
checks.detail: At L=64,T=1, one unqueried winning endpoint guess has expected nominal credit 32 regardless of hash length. Small probability alone cannot establish small weighted credit without an award/admission bound.

checks.name: quantum_distribution
checks.detail: The fixed 64-candidate, p=1/64, five-iteration strategy averages every subset by exact binomial multiplicity, retaining zero-winner worlds. Independent root De Moivre report matches the rational probability.

checks.name: quantum_resources
checks.detail: 320 forward + 320 inverse + 64 endpoint reconstruction + 64 independent verifier = 768 abstract step calls; own calls = 704. Expected nominal credit approximately 2237.382781586351 is an ideal strategy result, not a concrete circuit or quantum lower bound.

checks.name: authorization_and_scope
checks.detail: Public fixture keys and single-owner journal guarantees do not establish independent operators, real demand, current consumer FinalUse, settlement or a network-wide quota.

checks.name: offline_online
checks.detail: Finite-domain tables shift computation to preparation/storage. A new useful relation/profile and explicit amortization horizon are needed for intrinsic useful-work claims.

checks.name: production_boundary
checks.detail: Both specs remain HOLD with actual chainwork zero, no production registration or quantum qualification, and no assertion that finite tests exhaust optimal adversaries.
